name: Camp Killooleet
description_short: A small overnight camp on 300 acres with a private lake in Hancock, Vermont. It runs one full-summer session of about seven weeks, and first-time campers can commit to July only.

sources.note: ZIP from the camp's mailing address, PO Box 70, Hancock VT 05748. Tuition on this page is labeled 2026 ($14,500 full, $14,100 charged; $9,800 July only)

warnings: The page shows only the 2026 season, which ended August 16, 2026. As of today (2026-10-13), 2027 dates and prices have not been published.

There are two tuition figures: $14,300 is the full rate, and $13,800 is the reduced rate charged. Families who can afford it are asked to pay the full $14,300. The full-season session price is recorded as $13,800.
The Financial Aid option in CampMinder defaults to $10,000, and the camp later adjusts it to the agreed amount.
The address shown is a mailing PO Box (PO Box 70, Hancock VT 05748), not the camp's physical location.
The July-only session is open only to first-time campers.
unknowns: Whether meals are included (likely for overnight camp, but not stated)
